question.prompt: A rectangular sheet of paper \(ABCD\) has \(AB=6\) and \(BC=8\). Fold the paper so that point \(A\) coincides with point \(C\). The crease intersects \(BC\) at point \(E\). Find the length of \(CE\). (Write the result as a fraction.)

solutions.explanation: The crease is the perpendicular bisector of \(AC\), so \(EA=EC=x\). In right triangle \(ABE\), \(6^2+(8-x)^2=x^2\). Solving gives \(x=25/4\).
solutions.title: Use crease equidistance and Pythagoras
Equate distances to the folded vertices
Use midsegments and similar right triangles
